entries.name: Vietnamese Community of Minnesota Tết Festival
entries.capsule: The community's large public Tết fair, hosted since 1981, with performances, dragon dances and vendors.
entries.dateRule: Announced each year by the organizer, usually a January or February weekend near Tết, sometimes weeks earlier.

entries.whatItMarks: The community's welcome of the Lunar New Year; the 2026 fair was billed as "50 Years of Journey."
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Free at Burnsville Center in 2026, Saturday 11 a.m. to 9 p.m., Sunday noon to 6 p.m. MNopedia reports áo dài fashion, dragon dances, vendors and children's activities, and more than 20,000 people in January 2024. Earlier years used Union Depot and high schools.
